baseObservation.meaning: immutable preimage observation only; Git owns live facts

claimBoundary: This contract makes current semantic ownership, contributor task routing and repository evidence freshness machine-checkable. It creates no business write authority, no global UI resolver, no provider/deployment/human assurance claim and no new serial convergence slice.

ownerClasses.OWNER: may own the declared semantic slot
ownerClasses.ADAPTER: may translate protocol or representation without changing semantic authority
ownerClasses.OBSERVER: may inspect, annotate or diagnose but may not replace the owner
ownerClasses.COMPATIBILITY: temporary path with an explicit retirement condition; may not become the current owner by precedence
ownerClasses.RETIRED: lineage only; may not participate in the current mounted authority path

freshness.rule: A repository closure receipt is fresh only while every declared semantic input digest and every declared dependency receipt digest remains unchanged.
freshness.headBindingRule: Exact-head evidence is still required for PR acceptance; semantic input digests avoid invalidating unrelated closures for unrelated file changes.
